items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: We went over and, uh, we played on dedicated, we went up and played at the jam, we played. Paul, Barbary and myself.

ctx.x: Very, very, very fireman. And, uh, that's where Louie was.

Yeah. Clean up until he left here. I mean, I had some of them last, he came down here, he played, uh, one time they had a, there's something at the, at the Royal Orleans for him. During the concert time he was down here. We went over and, uh, we played on dedicated, we went up and played at the jam, we played. Paul, Barbary and myself. Most of the guys that knew him well. Mm-hmm. We went up and played different things. When he walked in, he was, first came up to the bass, he didn't see anybody's hand before he…
Do you remember what year that was? Years ago, I couldn't remember. I guess it's been a while. Yeah. Yeah. Um.
